         <p>Note that you must send back the goods by following the instructions available on

      <section class="a-section" id="GUID-189D34BF-F756-4879-B149-0D73223A3BFD__SECTION_75D8A63A99304C9EB6C9DDFE899F7945">

         <p>All prices are inclusive of legally applicable VAT.</p>
         <p>We list availability information for products sold by us on the website including
